rows.original_section: What UAE payroll does and does not involve
rows.old_text: **No tax on wages.** The UAE has no personal income tax. A natural person is only taxed on income under Corporate Tax, and only on business income; a natural person's Wage is outside it "regardless of the amount of Turnover". So there is nothing to calculate or withhold from an employee's pay for tax, and no employee tax return to file.

rows.old_text: **Employee or not is a question of fact.** The FTA says "whether a natural person is an employee and earns a salary or other form of remuneration as such, is a question of fact to be determined on a case-by-case basis". The payer withholds nothing either way; the obligation is the contractor's own.

rows.old_text: **No tax on wages.** The UAE has no personal income tax.
